title: Stop or background a running task from the Claude pane's task strip
notes: Claude Code: Ctrl+B backgrounds Bash and agents, a key stops subagents, /tasks shows an output tail. SDK: backgroundTasks(id?) (sdk.d.ts:3324), stopTask (3309); get_task_output (4361) is control-only, unverified on Query. Pane: chat-task-strip.ts only lists. Size M.

comments.body: Shipped in PR #109: the task strip picks a task with Alt+T, stops it with Alt+X and backgrounds it with Alt+B (chat-decision-5). Version 2.12.0.
